newsitem.title: SPAIN: Two planes collide at Spain military base,two dead.
newsitem.headline: Two planes collide at Spain military base,two dead.

text.p: Two military officers died on Friday when their plane collided with another light aircraft at a base near Madrid, the Ministry of Defence said.
A captain died on impact and his fellow crew member, a lieutenant, died in hospital. The two crew of the other aircraft emerged uninjured.
The Defence Ministry said it not know the reason for the crash which occurred during a practice session at the Getafe military base.
